hints.title: Treat the parameter as a constant
hints.body: Expand the curve before differentiating in x: y=4q2x+6q−2qx3−3x2. Here q is constant during this differentiation.
hints.recap: A parameter is held fixed when finding a curve’s gradient with respect to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></math>.
hints.pitfall: The term <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>q</mi></mrow></math> has derivative zero with respect to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></math>.

recall.reminder: A parameter is held fixed when finding a curve’s gradient with respect to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></math>.

hints.title: Evaluate at the specified input
hints.recap: Evaluating the derivative at a fixed point leaves a function of the parameter.
hints.pause: Find the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>q</mi></mrow></math> at the minimum of this upward quadratic.

recall.reminder: Evaluating the derivative at a fixed point leaves a function of the parameter.

hints.title: Complete the square in the parameter
hints.body: Factor out the leading coefficient of the parameter quadratic before completing its square. The minimum occurs when the squared bracket vanishes.
hints.recap: Completing the square identifies both the input of a quadratic minimum and its value.
hints.pitfall: The question asks for the parameter <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><mi>q</mi></mrow></math>, not the minimum gradient.
hints.pause: Complete the square yourself, then find the parameter value at the minimum.

recall.reminder: Completing the square identifies both the input of a quadratic minimum and its value.

solution:
Expanding gives y=4q2x+6q−2qx3−3x2, so dy/dx=4q2−6qx2−6x.

At x=−1 the gradient is 4q2−6q+6=4(q−34)2+154. Its least value occurs at q=34.

Answer F. The required answer is the parameter, rather than the gradient 15/4.
knowledgePattern: Differentiate in x then minimise the resulting parameter quadratic
